subject: Decision: Finalize SDE2 pay mix for Samir Ortiz
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: sign-off for SDE2 pay mix (Samir Ortiz)

Marissa —

Hiring update: Samir Ortiz (external candidate, current senior SWE at Acme Health) accepted our verbal interest but has a competing offer that is slightly higher cash. Hiring manager recommends the following final offer to be competitive and stay within our band guardrails:

- Base: $150,000 (within L3/L4 blended band)
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- RSU: 0.12% 4yr vest, 1y cliff (standard)
- One-time sign-on: $12,000 (prorated over 6 months) — manager requests this to close the gap

Karthik note: candidate would start ~June 1 and is asking for clarity on total comp and equity cadence. We have runway in the headcount bucket for SDE2 but this is near the top of the band. Please advise if we can approve the sign-on and the mix above or if we need to adjust equity vs cash. Attaching my comp matrix for the role.

Thanks,
Karthik

---
Attachment: comp_clearance_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sign-off for SDE2 pay mix (Samir Ortiz)

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifying Qs before I take to comp:

1) Is the $12k sign-on a hard requirement from the candidate (they asked for a cash component) or a manager preference to accelerate acceptance?
2) Is there any flexibility on start date (if we push to mid-June we might avoid proration complications)?
3) Please confirm the candidate's current total cash at Acme (base + bonus) so we can compare apples-to-apples.

If cash is the blocker, comp is more comfortable adjusting sign-on vs moving base above band. If the manager prefers equity uplift instead, propose cap at 0.15% RSU and no sign-on (that helps comp efficiency).

I'll queue this with Neha for clearance once we get the candidate cash details. Candidate resume attached for context.

-Marissa

---
Attachment: candidate_resume_sam_ortiz.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sign-off for SDE2 pay mix (Samir Ortiz)

Quick note from comp team —

We discussed offline. Given the competing offer context and Samir's seniority, comp approves the following as an exception within band:

- Base: $150,000 (no change)
- Target bonus: 12% (increase from 10%)
- RSU: 0.12% (unchanged)
- Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time)

Rationale: Small bump to target bonus plus a modest sign-on keeps base within band while improving near-term cash. Approve contingent on hiring manager confirming candidate start date and budget owner sign-off. Please log this in the comp clearance sheet (I updated the matrix).

Neha

---
Attachment: comp_clearance_matrix.xlsx (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: approved pay mix and next steps (Samir Ortiz)

Thanks — good tradeoff. Final approval summary (for offer letter):

- Base: $150,000
- Target bonus: 12%
- RSU: 0.12% (4yr vest, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time, payable within first payroll cycle)
- Start date: tentative June 1 (Karthik please confirm)

Next actions:
- Karthik: confirm start date and whether candidate needs relocation assistance.
- Neha: please route finalized comp to Legal for offer generation (offer_terms_draft.docx) and update HubSpot record.
- Laura: can you confirm we have headcount budget in the May commit? If yes, I will approve sending the offer to Sam and loop in Julia Park (external recruiter) on the candidate email.

I will hold off sending until Legal uploads the formal doc; aim to have candidate outreach by Friday EOD.

-Marissa Cole
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
